textbookBox.concept: Soil is a complex living ecosystem with bacteria, fungi, earthworms and insects. Humus, the dark organic part of soil, makes it fertile.

beats.en: Soil is a complex living ecosystem with bacteria, fungi, earthworms and insects. Humus, the dark organic part of soil, makes it fertile. If the same crop is grown again and again, the soil loses nutrients.
